slice: P3 selected unmarked MATERIAL normal auto-transform edit
scope: Unchanged imported modern-DXF MATERIAL source with an inferred complete normal tuple and qualified common carrier; isolated or composed typed normal AutoTransform change.

contract.operation: Bind exactly two outer integer group-75 fields around the inferred second group-42 boundary, verify their distinct decoded diffuse/normal values, and replace only the selected normal field.
contract.policy: The 0x07 allowed-bit mask is the existing parser/writer model admission policy. Autodesk names normal mapper group 75 and documents diffuse mapper flags 1, 2 and 4; it does not independently establish native normal bit meanings.
contract.atomicity: Reject invalid bits, unqualified field/presence/common/raw changes and late mutations without changing destination or caller; corrected retry succeeds on the same adapter. The emitted record is decoded and checked against the requested represented model.
contract.unqualified: Changed source bodies or unsupported normal fields, ambiguous/incomplete tuple or procedural profiles, cross-format caret strings, arbitrary source versions, native rendering, normal bit semantics and whole-document conversion.

validation.focusedControls: Seven edited values in 0..7 except unchanged 4 over four ASCII/binary source-output combinations (28), four combined blend/projection/tiling/auto edits, 20 invalid-bit/changed diffuse/presence/conflicting raw refusals with retry, and six late-callback mutation refusals with retry. Existing source-common, procedural and replay controls continue.
validation.chronology: Final normal and ASan builds used the frozen committed sources; the normal adapter object is byte-identical to the scratch peer-probe adapter object.

independentPeer.derivation: The retained selected source removes unrelated EZDXF_META root and DICTIONARY/DICTIONARYVAR objects; its selected MATERIAL identity and all 55 host fields match the independently authored original before document setup.
independentPeer.observations: Independent physical tag loader matched all 55 selected MATERIAL host fields and source identity in each output, changing only the second group-75 value. Ordinary peer tag interpretation does not establish native rendering or validity of the other allowed mask combinations.

limitations: The peer experiment uses a derived source with unrelated objects removed; it is not proof of whole-document fidelity.
No native CAD normal bit semantics, rendering, arbitrary source profiles, DWG parity or broad support claim follows.
